name: Documentation studio
description: Code/doc inputs -> draft -> fact check -> review. Produces a versioned document with source references.

steps.title: Draft {{document}}
steps.acceptance: Draft covers the requested scope with source references.
steps.instructions: Draft {{document}} from the provided code and documents. Reference source files inline.

steps.title: Fact check {{document}}
steps.acceptance: Every claim verified against a file or command output; mismatches listed.
steps.instructions: Verify every claim in the draft of {{document}} against the code. List mismatches.

steps.title: Review {{document}}
steps.instructions: Apply fact-check corrections to {{document}} and record the version.
